name: me.proton.core.accountrecovery.presentation.compose.ui.PasswordResetDialogActivity
description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this dialog during account recovery when a password reset is needed. It offers the password-reset step and can open Proton's account reset page.
disableEffect: If disabled, the user may be unable to continue the password-reset part of account recovery in the app.
